mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_banner_s ( banner_ttl, banner_image_file_sq, banner_link_url, banner_link_target_blank_yn, banner_start_dtm, banner_end_dtm, banner_is_active_yn, banner_is_deleted_yn, banner_display_order, banner_click_cnt ) VALUES ( #{request.bannerTitle}, #{bannerImageFileSq}, #{request.bannerLinkUrl}, #{linkTargetBlankYn}, #{request.startDtm}, #{request.endDtm}, #{bannerIsActiveYn}, 'N', #{request.displayOrder}, 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY
b.banner_sq b.banner_ttl b.banner_display_order b.banner_start_dtm b.banner_is_active_yn b.banner_click_cnt b.banner_display_order
${sortOrder} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.banner_sq AS bannerSq, IFNULL(CONCAT('/files/', f.file_save_nm), '') AS bannerImageUrl, b.banner_link_url AS bannerLinkUrl, b.banner_link_target_blank_yn AS linkTargetBlankYn, b.banner_display_order AS displayOrder
WHERE b.banner_is_active_yn = 'Y' AND b.banner_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND NOW() BETWEEN b.banner_start_dtm AND b.banner_end_dtm ORDER BY b.banner_display_order ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE tbl_banner_s
banner_ttl = #{request.bannerTitle}, banner_link_url = #{request.bannerLinkUrl}, banner_link_target_blank_yn = #{linkTargetBlankYn}, banner_display_order = #{request.displayOrder}, banner_start_dtm = #{request.startDtm}, banner_end_dtm = #{request.endDtm}, banner_is_active_yn = #{bannerIsActiveYn}, banner_image_file_sq = #{bannerImageFileSq}, banner_modified_at_dtm = NOW()
WHERE banner_sq = #{bannerSq} AND banner_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tbl_banner_s SET banner_is_deleted_yn = 'Y', banner_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE banner_sq = #{bannerSq} AND banner_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tbl_banner_s SET banner_is_active_yn = CASE WHEN banner_is_active_yn = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, banner_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE banner_sq = #{bannerSq} AND banner_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tbl_banner_s SET banner_is_active_yn = 'N', banner_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE banner_is_active_yn = 'Y' AND banner_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND banner_end_dtm < NOW()
UPDATE tbl_banner_s SET banner_click_cnt = banner_click_cnt + 1, banner_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE banner_sq = #{bannerSq} AND banner_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
